target_customer: Developers and enterprises running open weight models who want fast, cheap inference, and GPU engineers who use its tools
problem: Getting full speed from GPUs requires hand tuned kernels, which most teams cannot write, so inference is slower and costlier than it should be.
business_model: Usage based inference API priced per token from 0.05 USD per million input tokens, plus reserved capacity, dedicated deployments and enterprise model optimization
product_category: GPU kernel optimization and open model inference

founders.name: Jaber Jaber
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background. Product Hunt shows him posting the company's launches.

competitors.name: Standard Kernel
competitors.what: AI systems that generate GPU kernels to optimize AI workloads
competitors.funding_then: 20M USD seed led by Jump Capital

competitors.name: Kernelize
competitors.what: Platform to target AI accelerators built on the Triton open source project

technical_complexity.rationale: Writing and auto generating correct, fast CUDA and Triton kernels across NVIDIA and AMD is research grade and needs benchmarking and verification.

defensibility.rationale: Kernel expertise and open source reputation help, but well funded rivals chase the same problem and inference is a commodity market.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded kernel generation startups appeared in 2026. No acquisition of RightNow found.

market_need_then: Inference cost and GPU efficiency are central to AI spend. The site lists NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Samsung, AMD, Modal and Reddit as using its optimization, but the nature of those relationships is not explained.

branding.domain_note: Uses rightnowai.co. An unrelated CRM product also called RightNow exists.

identity.logo: Has a dedicated brand page covering logo, mark, colors and typeface, details not retrieved
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, with the line The kernel lab behind instant AI

branding.community_and_virality: Launched several products on Product Hunt, posted on NVIDIA developer forums, and released the open source AutoKernel framework in 2026, which MarkTechPost covered.

brand_strength.rationale: Open source release and repeated launches gave visibility among GPU developers, though the name is generic.

pivots.from: GPU native CUDA code editor and profiler (launched 2025)
pivots.to: Inference API on optimized open models plus enterprise kernel optimization
pivots.why: Reason not stated in sources, inferred only from product pages

outcome_analysis: RightNow is an active Fall 2026 company that moved from a CUDA code editor to an optimized inference API and open source kernel tools. Public funding is not found beyond YC. Strengths are technical depth and developer visibility. Risks are well funded kernel startups and a commoditized inference market.
notes: Crunchbase page shows placeholder funding text, so no round is recorded. Editor launch date appears as March 2025 and Product Hunt November 2025 in different snippets. Makora round date not confirmed. The pivot reason is not sourced so treat the pivot as a product shift. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition.
